ground_truth_protocol.description: IEC 60870-5-104 telecontrol over TCP/2404. Every APDU starts with the 6-byte APCI; I-format APDUs carry an ASDU whose first octet (type identification) selects the message type. Derived from the Wireshark/tshark dissection of the benchmark capture (dol/truth-file-derivation/scripts/build_truth.py): fields at a fixed offset in at least 60% of a type's messages, bitfields sharing a byte merged, arrays of 3+ equal fields and variable-position content kept as one bytes field (the modbus.json convention for register arrays); types with fewer than 5 messages are omitted.
ground_truth_protocol.offset_convention: APCI fields use wire-absolute offsets 0..5; ASDU types are relative to the ASDU (offset 0 = type identification = wire offset 6).

message_types.name: IEC 104 APCI
message_types.description: Application Protocol Control Information: start byte 0x68, APDU length, four control octets (I-, S- or U-format). Offsets are wire-absolute.
